summary: Added organization and operating visuals and corrected the term index to the canonical collection format.

expectedEntries.text: Added four illustrative organization arrangements and eight visuals covering context ownership, evaluation results, recovery, the trial schedule, complete cost, unit cost, productive reuse and the final decision.
expectedEntries.rationale: The visuals help leaders compare coordination choices and the existing synthetic examples. Company sizes are illustrative total-company headcounts, not reorganization thresholds.

expectedEntries.text: Subsection titles omit decimal prefixes. The term index now uses alphabetical groups, one term per entry and linked printed-page references, matching the collection format.
expectedEntries.rationale: Replaced dense paragraphs of quoted section titles with a scannable index. Page references are measured from the final PDF pagination; existing section links remain available.
